plan.notes: Official Concordia University Chicago 2025-2026 catalog (archive), Elementary Education BS requirements (ISBE licensure program; College of Education Manual rules apply; grade C or higher required in major courses). The catalog publishes official degree requirements with no official semester sequence; collected as a single requirements block. Per-course credits are published for the gen-ed content courses (3 each), the student teaching internship (EDEL-4920: 15), and seminar (EDUC-4985: 0); all other course credit cells were blank in the catalog and were NOT invented - recorded as official block totals (Foundational 15, Elementary Education 12, Professional 27). Captured blocks sum to 81 hours; the program total is 120 credits, with the remaining 39 hours of general education and electives not itemized in this requirements capture.

courses.title: Foundational courses in education (15 hours)
courses.choice_note: 15-hour block; per-course credit cells blank in catalog (not invented). Courses: EDUC-1050 Introduction to American Education (LTE candidates take EDUC-1060); EDUC-1070 Media and Technology in the Classroom; EDUC-2020 Human and Cognitive Development (may satisfy gen ed); EDUC-2050 Teaching in Diverse Classrooms; EDUC-2090 Characteristics and Instruction of Exceptional Learners.

courses.title: Elementary education courses (12 hours, prerequisites to professional)
courses.choice_note: 12-hour block; per-course credit cells blank in catalog (not invented). Courses: EDUC-2400 Literature for Children, Adolescents and Young Adults (may satisfy gen ed); EDUC-2500 Foundations of Literacy; MAT-1411 Mathematics for Teachers: Number and Measurement; MAT-1611 Math for Teachers: Geometry, Statistics, Function.

courses.title: Professional education courses (27 hours; teacher candidacy required)
courses.choice_note: 27-hour block; per-course credit cells blank in catalog (not invented). Block I (same semester): EDEL-4901 Content and Methods for Elementary Art; EDEL-4902 Content and Methods for Elementary Music; EDEL-4903 Content and Methods for Elementary Social Sciences; EDEL-4922 Classroom Management and Professionalism in Elementary and Middle Grades. Block II (same semester): EDEL-4905 Content and Methods for Elementary Math; EDEL-4906 Content and Methods for Elementary Physical Education & Health; EDEL-4907 Content and Methods for Elementary Science; EDEL-4923 Assessment: Elementary and Middle Grades. Literacy methods: EDEL-3500 Content and Methods for Elementary Literacy.
